description: Canonical Research OS event envelope. `os_version` records the workspace OS_VERSION at append time; events without it are legacy (pre-7.3) and audit grades their findings as warnings instead of errors.
os_version: workspace OS_VERSION at append time ("unknown" when the file is absent); absent on legacy events — never required
integrity: Each event stores prev_hash and event_hash; the ledger is append-only and hash-chained.
